digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflows and reusable test job configuration
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs run for hours without progress or completion due to absence of a job-level timeout-minutes bound, forcing manual cancellation to clear the queue
Pre-fix Gerrit stacks (1129/1130/1131/1136) that omit commit 96a0d5c3f trigger unbounded per-blob lazy-fetch during materialization, causing hangs independent of test logic

test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract times out because FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignores startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing an infinite loop through the same non-empty result page
Reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job inherits GitHub's 360-minute default timeout when timeout-minutes is omitted, allowing long-running failures to block queued runs indefinitely
Setting jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 in the reusable workflow bounds pytest matrix execution to a safe upper limit and prevents queue blockage from hangs
Implementing pagination offset slicing in FakeJiraClient.search_issues to honor startAt/maxResults parameters eliminates the infinite-loop test timeout for paged-search consumers
